# Recorded EDINET regressions

UTF-8 TSV projections of the original UTF-16 EDINET type-5 CSV ZIPs. Element IDs,
contexts, units and values are verbatim; numeric facts and share/lease notes are
retained, unrelated narrative text blocks omitted. Downloaded 2026-09-29 through
the EDINET v2 API, with the API credential omitted.
